sessions.description: List of dtach sessions to configure. Each session defines a command to run under dtach, the socket path, and operational mode and options. Required for any configuration to be useful. Items are flat objects — see items schema below for fields per session item. Note: 'command' must be a list of arguments, not a shell string — split before passing here if needed (e.g. in deployment tooling). However, per constraints, .split is not used in this template; only pass pre-split lists as values. Default is empty list, producing no sessions in rendered output (valid but no-op).
